svg.text: WPA Heyball rules feedback · 中英 shipping copy
FLAT TEXT/LAYOUT PROOF · NOT GPU · PROFILE INCOMPLETE
illegal_break · warning_triangle
开球条件未满足 / Break requirements not met
等待对手选择接受台面或重新摆球。 / Wait for the opponent's accept-table or rerack decision.
no_object_ball_contact · crossed_circle
未碰到目标球 / No object-ball contact
回合交给对手；对手获得自由球。 / Turn passes; the opponent receives ball in hand.
wrong_first_contact · crossed_circle
首碰球错误 / Wrong ball contacted first
回合交给对手；对手获得自由球。 / Turn passes; the opponent receives ball in hand.
no_rail_after_contact · rail_with_slash
碰球后无球触库 / No rail after contact
回合交给对手；对手获得自由球。 / Turn passes; the opponent receives ball in hand.
cue_ball_scratch · cue_ball_down_arrow
母球落袋 / Cue-ball scratch
回合交给对手；自由球放置功能可用后放置母球。 / Turn passes; place the cue ball when ball-in-hand placement is available.
cue_ball_off_table · ball_outside_rectangle
母球离台 / Cue ball off the table
回合交给对手；对手获得自由球。 / Turn passes; the opponent receives ball in hand.
object_ball_off_table · ball_outside_rectangle
目标球离台 / Object ball off the table
回合交给对手；对手获得自由球。 / Turn passes; the opponent receives ball in hand.
illegal_eight_ball · eight_ball_octagon
8号球非法入袋 / Illegal 8-ball
本局结束；对手获胜。 / The match ends; the opponent wins.
PENDING · NOT FOR PRODUCT · rules_shield
开球判定选择 / Break decision
选择接受当前台面或重新摆球。
[1] 接受台面 / Accept table
[2] 重摆—对手开球 / Rerack — opponent breaks
[3] 重摆—原开球方开球 / Rerack — original breaker
PENDING · NOT FOR PRODUCT · reset_arrow
开球时8号球入袋 / 8-ball on the break
8号球必须重置点位或重新摆球；这不算获胜。
[1] 重置8号球并继续 / Spot 8-ball and continue
[2] 重置8号球；开球线后自由球 / Spot 8-ball; ball in hand behind head string
[3] 重新摆球 / Rerack
PENDING · NOT FOR PRODUCT · warning_triangle
僵局 / Stalemate
按既定程序已无法继续推进比赛。
[1] 确认并执行重摆程序 / Confirm and follow rerack procedure
PENDING · NOT FOR PRODUCT · cue_ball
自由球 / Ball in hand
只能在当前规则允许的区域内放置母球。
[1] 放置母球 / Place cue ball
[2] 确认位置 / Confirm placement
